newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Coles sells properties for A$53 mln.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Coles sells properties for A$53 mln.

text.p: Retailer Coles Myer Ltd said on Monday it had sold nine supermarkets to Countrywide Retail Trust for A$21 million and had sold its 25 percent interest in six sub-regional shopping centres to the Industry Superannuation Trust for A$32.7 million.
Coles Myer chief executive Peter Bartels said the sales were above book value and that he was pleased the properties had been purchased by organisations with whom Coles had strong relationships.
"The purchase by Country Wide expands the number of Coles Myer anchored centres they currently own to more than 20 and demonstrates their confidence in the future growth of our brands," Bartels said.
